description:
## Why

Second leg of PKIX-g9vc. Implements the actual x509-limbo corpus reader. Independent of validation_time threading (.1) — they can be developed in parallel.

## What

New module `pkix-difftest/src/corpus/limbo.rs` implementing the existing `Corpus` trait (`src/corpus/mod.rs:47-55`). Modelled on `PkitsCorpus` (`src/corpus/pkits.rs`) which is the closest precedent.

1. **Serde structs** mirroring `limbo-schema.json` 1:1. `#[serde(default)]` on the 9 optional/defaulted fields. `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` at the testcase level so schema drift fails loudly. Closed enums:
   - `ValidationKind` (`CLIENT`/`SERVER`)
   - `ExpectedResult` (`SUCCESS`/`FAILURE`)
   - `Feature` (13 values, kebab-case)
   - `Importance`, `PeerKind`, `KeyUsage`, `KnownEKUs`, `SignatureAlgorithm` (inert; for forward-compat)
2. **`LimboCorpus::load(manifest_path: &Path)`** — reads the full `limbo.json` (40MB; eager parse is fine — `PkitsCorpus` does the same with vectors.json).
3. **Default filter** (RFC 5280-shaped, not pedantic-webpki):
   - `validation_kind == SERVER` (drop 10 CLIENT cases)
   - `features.is_empty()` (drop 36 featured cases — has-crl, name-constraint-dn, max-chain-depth, pedantic-*, denial-of-service, has-policy-constraints, rfc5280-incompatible-with-webpki)
   - `max_chain_depth.is_none()` (catches the one outlier without the feature tag)
   - `crls.is_empty()` (defensive; redundant with feature filter)
   Filter logic and rationale documented inline in code comments so future loosening is principled.
4. **Per-testcase mapping**:
   - `peer_certificate` + `untrusted_intermediates` + `trusted_certs` → `Chain.certs_der` (DER bytes, leaf-first ordering — same order as PKITS).
   - `crls` → `Chain.crls` (currently always empty after filter, but model it now).
   - `validation_time` → `Chain.validation_time_unix` via RFC 3339 parser. When `null`, use a deterministic default (e.g. `1700000000` = 2023-11-14 — "middle of the limbo era") rather than `SystemTime::now()` so runs are reproducible. Decision documented in the bead's design notes.
   - `expected_result` SUCCESS → `Some(Verdict::Pass)`, FAILURE → `Some(Verdict::Fail { reason: String::new() })`.
   - `name`: testcase `id` (already namespaced with `::`).
5. **Iterator semantics**: per the `Corpus` trait contract (`mod.rs:53`), must NOT silently skip — filtered-out cases are dropped at `load()` time, not `iter()` time. `iter()` yields the filtered set; bad PEM in a kept case yields `Err` not silent-drop.
6. **Unit tests**:
   - Schema deserialises every testcase in `limbo.json` (sanity check; pin to current commit hash).
   - Filter counts match expected (9763 SERVER → ~9727 after feature+depth+crl filter).
   - One round-trip test per id-namespace (e.g. one `cve::*`, one `pathlen::*`, one `rfc5280::*`) verifying `Chain` construction.
   - RFC 3339 parser handles all year prefixes present in corpus (1970, 2016-2027).

## Acceptance

- [ ] `LimboCorpus` struct + impl in `src/corpus/limbo.rs`.
- [ ] Public via `src/corpus/mod.rs`.
- [ ] Default filter retains ~9,700+ testcases.
- [ ] All structural fields modelled, even inert ones (forward-compat).
- [ ] Unit tests cover schema parse + filter counts + at least one chain construction per namespace.

## Out of scope

- CLI wiring (PKIX-g9vc.3).
- Running the full corpus to produce a baseline (PKIX-g9vc.4).
- Adding new dependencies. `serde_json` is already in pkix-difftest's Cargo.toml. RFC 3339 parsing: implement inline (50 LOC) using the same approach as pkix-ct's `log_list.rs` schema module (per memory `pkix-baac-2-ct-log-list-google-json`), avoiding a new `chrono`/`time` workspace dep.

## Filed as

Decomposition of PKIX-g9vc. Independent of .1; both can run in parallel. CLI in .3 depends on this one.
title: pkix-difftest: LimboCorpus loader (parse limbo.json + filter)
